The '''droid optimized interface''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] component that was used to increase the speed and quality of droids' interactions with [[Computer/Legends|computer]] systems. The interface was quite common during the [[Dark Wars]], a series of conflicts between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Triumvirate|remnants]] of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]].

==Description==
The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] optimized interface was a droid component that was [[Color/Legends|gray]] in color and could be installed on most droid models.<ref name="install">In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', the interface could be installed on droids of any level.</ref> The optimized design of the interface allowed droids to interact with [[Computer/Legends|computer]] systems more quickly and decisively.<ref name="kotor2" />

==History==
During the [[Dark Wars]],<ref name="kotorcg" /> a series of conflicts that occurred between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Triumvirate|remnants]] of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], the droid optimized interface was a common type of droid component.<ref name="kotor2" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="kotorcg" /> the droid optimized interface was sold by [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] for around fifty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="kotor2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The droid optimized interface made its first appearance in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', a [[2004]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] produced by [[Obsidian Entertainment]].<ref name="kotor2" /> In the game, the interface was identified as a class 1 droid upgrade, which meant that droids of any level could have it equipped. The interface provided droids with a small increase to their computer use skill, and the item could be found in random locations throughout the game, as well as for sale at merchants. However, the player was not guaranteed to find the item every time the game was played through.<ref name="kotor2" />
